root.claim: A deterministic multitape Turing machine multiplies $n$-bit integers in $O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$ time with $\kappa=2^{-182}$.
root.method: reduce multiplication to convolution, accelerate the tape procedures by a power saving, then chain the reductions to an exact product

motivation.text: The cost n log n comes from Theta(log n) transform levels each costing a scan; a power saving in movement and arithmetic per level lowers the log factor to a power below 1.

root.salient: The exponent kappa=2^-182 is a minuscule fixed constant, yet a strict power saving over lg n.

adds.meaning: The fixed exponent 2^-182 by which the logarithmic factor is reduced.
